text: ＊から　ＮＧとの　へんじが　きてしまいました…

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened, often to your regret. きてしまいました = 'it came, unfortunately'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と gives the content of the reply, and の links it to the noun. ＮＧとの　へんじ = 'a reply saying NG'.
